items.name: Ancient Silver Mirror
items.appearance: A classic silver mirror with mysterious patterns on the sides.
items.function: Unknown

items.name: Artificial Death Product's White Feathers
items.appearance: White feather stained with yellow oil.
items.function: They can be sacrificed to Artificial Death or wielder of Death Uniqueness to receive a response.

items.name: Authority Holder's Under-the-table Transaction
items.function: It simplifies complex deals by inserting items into a box and stating clear requirements.
items.downside: It has limited uses. Each use increases the risk of encountering evil creatures in future transactions.

items.name: Azik's Copper Whistle
items.function: It can summon one of Azik's messengers.
items.downside: It attracts undeads.

items.name: Beatrice's Necklace
items.function: Corresponds to a total of five desires: lust, appetite, acting, and fulfillment.
items.downside: The wearer will become more excited than usual, and their various desires will significantly increase.

items.name: Black Primordial Demoness Figurine
items.appearance: A pitch-black, palm-sized figurine of a beautiful woman with snake-like hair.
items.function: It is able to suppress non-conscious diseases, shielding the user from them.

items.name: Botis' Traveler's Bag
items.appearance: A black pocket the size of a grown man's palm.
items.function: A hidden space that can store items.

items.name: Bottomless Wine
items.function: Restores stamina and spirituality after drinking it.
items.downside: If it is consumed more than once a day, the user will become a drunkard.

items.name: Cheek's Rings
items.function: It can make the bearer a vessel for the Primordial Demoness' descent.
items.downside: The descent puts a strain on the vessel.

items.name: Circle of Binding
items.function:
1. It can use the Circle Inhabitant effect nine times, each Circle Inhabitant lasting no fewer than three times and no more than nine times.
2. Whether or not the Circle Inhabitant uses are exhausted, this bracelet contaminated by Inevitability powers will enhance the abilities of Fate Appropriation, Fate Exchange, Magnified Fate, and Compelling Fate to the Circle Inhabitant level.
items.downside:
1. Even just carrying this silver bracelet will unknowingly attract Inevitability boon recipients and be viewed with hostility by them.
2. Each use of Circle Inhabitant will result in a period of bad luck, the specifics varying depending on the user's status.

items.name: Corpse Wax Candle
items.appearance: A wax candle encased in a small glass vial with a light yellow and red hue.
items.function: Allows user to form a pact with the City of Calamity.
items.downside: Without the required level or protection, the user will get corrupted and lose control.

items.name: Death Masks
items.appearance: Golden masks streaked with black and white paint.
items.function:
1. Protects the wearer from the corrosion of the aura of death.
2. Transforms the wearer into an undead creature.
items.downside:
1. The purification of sunlight and lightning will be fatal to transformed undead.
2. If a living person wears it for too long, they will truly become deceased.

items.name: Demon Mask
items.function: Seals the thoughts and abilities of the person wearing it

items.name: Endless Cosmos
items.appearance: An oil painting depicting a strange cosmos
items.function: Allows the Inextinguishable Ravings and the Circle of Inevitability to transmit a bit of Their power into the barrier.

items.name: Fallen Mercury
items.appearance: A slivery-black dirk, twice the size of a normal one, covered with strange patterns.
items.function:
When it draws blood from a target, it can exchange one of the target's fate with one it had stored. It cannot injure the target during the process.
If there is no fate stored in it to be exchanged, it has to completely kill the target to take one of his fate.
items.downside: It has the ability to turn most living beings that come into contact with it into its slaves.

items.name: Featureless Doll
items.function: Appearance Morphing, Paper Figurine Subtitutes, Flaming Jump, and Danger Intuition.
items.downside: Weak bad luck and risk of losing identity.

items.name: Fortune Accessory
items.function: Increases the owner's luck.

items.name: Groselle's Travels
items.appearance: Ordinary-looking book with a brown goatskin cover.
items.function: Collecting information from the recreated subconscious of those who had died under the influences of the book.
items.downside: Those who had a long contact, or had their blood dropped into this book, would inevitably be transported into the minor world inside the book.

items.name: Harvest Sacrifice
items.function: Inflicts wounds that drain the target's life force when tainted with corresponding blood.

items.name: Ice Amulet
items.function: Allows seven traversals through the Mirror World or fourteen transmissions of information.

items.name: Klein's Gold Coins
items.function:
1. They are mediums which allow the user to participate in The Fool's Dream.
2. They can enhance one's divination accuracy and the ability to resist outside interference.

items.name: Klein's Iron Cigar Case
items.appearance: An iron cigar case with signs of corrosion.
items.function:
*Carries the aura of The Fool.
*Resistant to corrosion.

items.name: Lilith's Ring
items.appearance: A red ring with a blood-colored gem.
items.function:
1. Make the wearer more charming.
2. Simulates a "silver" full moon.
3. Summons spirit world creatures as strong as the user for around 5 minutes.
items.downside: The user must drink a bottle of human blood every hour or else his blood will boil and death will occur in 15 minutes.

items.name: Mechanical Music Box
items.function: The potential to either kill or drive anyone who hears its music into madness.
items.downside: The owner must hear it for at least ten seconds.

items.name: Mirror World Fragments
items.appearance: A mirror fragment with a black, nearly lightless surface.
items.function: Ability to create Mirror People.

items.name: Moon Paper Figurine
items.function: Can replace user against fatal injury or direct attack against the Soul Body.
items.downside: Make's the user feel slightly cold

items.name: Moon Puppet
items.appearance: A slender puppet embedded with dried grass and flowers.

items.name: Mutated Paper Figurine
items.function: It has the remnant aura of the Artificial Death.

items.name: Painting Album
items.function: The objects drawn on it might become alive and stay so for a short period of time.
items.downside: Never to respond to the knocks coming from the painting paper.

items.name: Persona Masks
items.function:
1. Each mask can amplify the knowledge and emotions corresponding to its sin to help the wearer realize their own problems.
2. Allows the wearer to enter the Garden of Eden.
items.downside: They will also bring some negative effects, and unknowingly change the wearer's personality.

items.name: Proliferation Necklace
items.appearance: A necklace with black miniature rhinoceros horn
items.function: Charms a person
items.downside: It would corrupt both the user and the one it was used on

items.name: Ring of the Sea Queen
items.function: A high-level Steal ability usable only once.
items.downside: The ancient Angel Amon will take notice of you.

items.name: Sanguine Anesthesia Gas
items.function: Cause deep slumber that lasts for more than three hours.

items.name: Seven-Stone Bracelet
items.appearance: A bracelet with three diamonds flanked by four different-coloured gems.
items.function: Allows user to travel through the spirit world.
items.downside: The user will hear random sounds when wearing it.

items.name: Shadow Cloak
items.function: Allows user to blend into shadows.

items.name: The Magician's Traveler's Bag
items.function:
1. It conceals another dimension within and can accommodate a vast array of items.
2. While within the bag, Beyonder characteristics do not require regular relocation, and the negative effects of mystical items will significantly diminish.
items.downside: It needs resealing and reinforcement every six months; otherwise, it will lose its mystical abilities and become ordinary.

items.name: Traveler Bracelet
items.function: Allows user to travel through the spirit world
items.downside: The user will hear strange, faint murmurings during the full moon or blood moon

items.name: White Primordial Demoness Figurine
items.appearance: A pure white, palm-sized bone figurine of a beautiful woman with snake-like hair.
items.function:
1. Possessing anti-divination and early warning abilities, it can also assist in performing rituals.
2. It is able to suppress non-conscious diseases, shielding the user from them.
